Initial release — unified sports data and endurance events research via the Crawlora API.

- Pulls live scores, standings, rosters, and player/team stats from ESPN (most sports), SofaScore (global soccer and others), MLB, and Strava (routes, clubs, challenges).
- Returns clean, normalized JSON for all supported endpoints.
- Full endpoint reference included; easy examples for command-line or curl usage.
- Free API key & 2,000 credits/month; only public data, no scraping required.
- Comprehensive coverage: major US and global sports, league standings, stats, live updates, route/club search for endurance sports.
- Security best practices: API key via environment variable only.
